title: The Taylor Swift era your year is stuck in
dek: Forget your favourite singles. Twelve questions about how you are actually living right now, and which era it sounds like.

questions.prompt: Your album is being written whether you like it or not. Track one opens with:

options.label: A door closing in another city

questions.prompt: One week in a cabin with no signal. The bag you packed contains:

options.label: Nothing useful and a disposable camera

questions.prompt: The bridge of your year sounds like:
You can be nostalgic for a time you didn't enjoy.
I check who watched my story and build a theory.
Your ex posts a photo in a place you recommended. Alone.

options.label: Post something better from somewhere better
Send it to the group chat. Say nothing
Genuinely hope they had a nice time
Log off and write two verses about it

questions.prompt: Pick the room you'd write it in.

options.label: A cabin with one window and bad signal
options.alt: A wooden cabin room with a window

options.label: A city flat above a noisy street
options.alt: A city apartment window overlooking buildings

options.label: A diner booth at closing time
A studio with the lights low
options.alt: A recording studio interior with warm lighting

questions.prompt: A friend asks for brutal honesty about their new relationship.

options.label: Tell them a story that answers it

questions.prompt: I feel everything at full volume.
The version of you at nineteen deserves an apology.
You get exactly what you wanted. First reaction:

options.label: Cry a bit, then celebrate properly

results.name: Debut
results.tagline: Small town, big list of people to prove wrong
results.blurb: You're at the start and it's obvious to everyone but you. Everything is very earnest, slightly too loud, and completely sincere. You write things down, you practise, you still say yes to everything. This is the part you'll be nostalgic for later without warning.
results.watchOut: You don't have to prove anything to the people who already left. Keep going anyway.

results.name: Fearless
results.tagline: Hopeful, in a way that costs something
results.blurb: You keep opening the door even though you know how it went last time. Not naive — deliberately hopeful. You'd rather get excited and be wrong than stay guarded and be safe, which is either the bravest thing about you or the most expensive.
strengths: Makes other people braver by going first
results.watchOut: Optimism needs receipts too. Notice what the pattern is telling you.

results.name: Red
results.blurb: This is a loud year. The highs are ridiculous, the lows are theatrical, and you're not apologising for either. You feel things in primary colours and you write them down. It's exhausting to be near and it is also the most alive you've been in ages.
results.watchOut: Not every feeling needs a public release date. Let one thing settle first.

results.tagline: New city, new haircut, same brain
results.blurb: You've moved. Not necessarily geographically — the version of you that cared what they thought has been retired. You're making sharp decisions, taking photos, and being slightly unbearable about a new city. It's working.
strengths: Reinvents without mourning the old self
Turns a fresh start into actual momentum
results.watchOut: The old feelings came with you. The new city isn't a cure, it's a backdrop.

results.name: Reputation
results.tagline: Outlived the story they told about you
results.blurb: You've been misread, and instead of correcting every version you built something they can't ignore. You're less available, more selective, and quietly enjoying the fact that the people who wrote you off are watching. It's not revenge. It's receipts.
results.watchOut: A reputation is a wall as well as a weapon. Leave a door unlocked.

results.name: Lover
results.tagline: Soft on purpose, not by accident
results.blurb: You're in a generous phase. You've decided that being warm is braver than being cool, and you're going around saying nice things and meaning them. There's still teeth underneath, but you're choosing to lead with the good stuff and it's changing your week.
strengths: Says 'I love you' without a joke attached
results.watchOut: Softness isn't sameness. You're allowed to disagree with people you adore.

results.name: Folklore
results.tagline: Inside, in the rain, writing it all down
results.blurb: You've gone quiet and inward. Not sad exactly — observant. You're collecting stories about other people, walking the long way, and finding that the fictional version of your life is easier to look at. This is the most honest you've been in a while.
strengths: Sees the story underneath the event
results.watchOut: The cabin is comfortable. Open a window before the year ends.

results.name: Midnights
results.tagline: Awake at 3am with the full archive
results.blurb: Everything happens in your head between midnight and four. You replay conversations, rewrite them better, and arrive at conclusions you'll forget by breakfast. You're not indecisive — you're thorough, at the worst possible hour, about things that are already over.
strengths: Reads a situation from every angle
Finds the truth in the small hours
results.watchOut: 3am is a bad editor. Write it down, decide at noon.
